table.name: TLGNC_SHSAREA_RESTR_TRUCK_TYPE
table.description: Table used to store truck type priority and limitations for a delivery setting (restriction) of a shipto sales area. See limitation purpose at tlgnc_shipto_truck_type_cem/agg. The table contains prio defaults to be applied on top of the possible truck types enabled on ship-to level. Unlike for tlgnc_shipto_truck_type_cem/agg prio = 0 setting is saved, and means that by default on order taking the value should be disabled (shown with x), and if used as default, the truck type should be disabled for the order based on this default.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAREA_RESTR_ID
column.description: FK to tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr. The dispokarte default to which the preferences belong.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_type_cd. Type of the truck: 2-axle, 3-axle, 4-axle, 5-axle or semi-trailer truck (Sattelschlepper).

column.name: EVALUATION_PRIORITY
column.description: Priority hints to evaluate possible truck types for this default. 0: Forbidden. As default only forbid is possible to be specified. Value defined here is overrideable on call center, but counts will count as the initial setting if the default is used on a certain order taking source.
